title: Original model frames and normalized maps to per-point metric sections

obligations.constructed_input: Supplied embedded model frames, original memberships, and normalized scalar210 comparisons.
obligations.justification: Frame extraction and surjectivity derive generators and image equality; no existence premise is discarded.

obligations.required_input: Original point field, actual evaluated pair and canonical/Hodge objects.
obligations.constructed_input: Same original point field and pair; same good lattices; supplied bad model lattices are retained as exact submodules.
obligations.justification: assembled_bad/assembled_good and metricSections_a0 identify the concrete consumers; both section values are definitionally retained.

obligations.required_input: Every admissible point, all finite and infinite places, all Fin2 sections.
obligations.constructed_input: New constructor works for each displayed admissible point; LocalComparisons quantifies all finite places; bad frame data quantify exactly denominator-excluded places.
obligations.justification: No existence for every point is claimed; good/bad split is exhaustive, includes primes dividing210.

obligations.required_input: Actual scalar210 image and multiplication product, fixed generic frame.
obligations.constructed_input: Surjective linear maps between the specified embedded submodules with literal scalar formula.
obligations.justification: scalar_image_of_surjective proves exact submodule equality; no unproved norm or image equation is a new field. Native global KS normalization is still an input obligation.

obligations.required_input: Original scaled coordinate32u/v, J² sections, factor210, Yuan vs original shift.
obligations.constructed_input: Existing constructor unchanged with factor210 and independently supplied actual Hodge metric/degree.
obligations.justification: No level/ramification factor omitted; existing bound uses hYuan-log pi. This slice does not prove actual Hodge provenance or archimedean isometry.

obligations.required_input: Exact original MetricSections, then existing CMInputs/NonCMInputs.toLegacy.
obligations.constructed_input: Existing OriginalKSLatticeMetricSections.metricSections invoked with extracted generators and proved image identity.
obligations.justification: No new section pair/field/Hodge metric substituted; CM and nonCM numerical records remain separately supplied, not produced.

obligations.required_input: Refined realization and original height/soundness route.
obligations.justification: The globally quantified realization remains open; no active packet or downstream historical source is altered.

obligations.required_input: Actual historical arguments and source-specific acceptance.
obligations.constructed_input: Read maximal-KS note and formal elliptic Hodge and lattice/consumer modules at pinned commit.
obligations.justification: Prior classical justification found; not reaccepted as formal producer. Prior source/static reviews do not authorize this new argument.

obligations.required_input: Independent source review and hosted Lean before proof claims.
obligations.constructed_input: Three isolated new sources, original dependency closure unchanged, no local Lean execution.
obligations.justification: Static hashes/no-admission/import checks only initially. Independent review pending and full hosted compilation blocked upstream; neither is proof of GeometricRealization.
